content: {"episode_id":"ep-05080","cpt":"93271","denial_carc":"CO-97","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-97 denial bundling CPT 93271 (cardiac event monitoring), as the indication note documents a patient with a history of paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0) and recurrent episodes of syncope (R55) that are not adequately captured by standard ambulatory monitoring. The note states that cardiac event monitoring is indicated for extended rhythm assessment in order to correlate these intermittent symptoms with underlying arrhythmias and determine the etiology of the collapse. Because this extended rhythm assessment addresses a distinct clinical question documented in the indication note, separate reimbursement of CPT 93271 is warranted rather than bundling under CO-97. We request reconsideration of the outstanding balance of 357.79 for this service."}
